visualCharacteristics.layout: 3-up grid or horizontal scroller with arrows when >3 items
visualCharacteristics.notes: rounded 12px corners, white label box with chevron over bottom of photo

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile, 2 cells: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = H3 title + description paragraph + link (the link becomes the whole-tile link); more than 3 rows render as a horizontal scroller
